method: score = feas(0-3) * impact(0-3) / log10(cost+10); ties broken by IIT-axiom-coverage breadth

ranking.rationale: Direct PyPhi Phi_max computation in SIM small-net (4-8 nodes) under noise-injection 'anesthesia'. Tests INFORMATION + INTEGRATION + EXCLUSION postulates simultaneously. Closest analog to original animal-IIT direct Phi measurement (Leung used real LFP but Phi is the metric — substrate-portable). Reuses Edlund/Albantakis (TOP-5 #1, #2) PyPhi infrastructure → zero marginal infrastructure cost.
falsifier_preregister_5: F1: Phi_max under high-noise NOT lower than baseline (d<0.5) -> REJECT anesthesia-Phi-attenuation
F2: Phi collapse occurs at noise level orthogonal to information-loss (channel capacity) -> dissociation flag
F3: PyPhi compute fails at 8-node SIM (>O(2^n) intractability) -> degrade to 4-node
F4: Phi_max trajectory not monotonic in noise temperature -> flag non-graded LOC
F5: random-network control shows identical Phi(noise) curve -> REJECT integration-specific attribution

ranking.rationale: Tests EXCLUSION postulate — IIT predicts that dual concurrent tasks should yield two transient maximal complexes (split). CLM dual-prompt setup: feed 2 independent prompts via attention-masked partition, measure cross-partition mutual-information vs within-partition. Highest-impact ANALOGIZE for distinguishing IIT vs GNWT (GNWT predicts single global broadcast). H100 pod direct.
falsifier_preregister_5: F1: cross-partition MI not lower than within-partition (no split detected) -> REJECT exclusion analog
F2: GNWT global-broadcast control (full-attention) shows same MI pattern -> dissociation failure
F3: split scales with partition entropy not task structure -> trivial-split flag
F4: CLM hidden-state cross-MI dominated by token-level overlap -> control via paraphrase
F5: effect vanishes at >7B param scale -> capability-dependent, weakens portability

ranking.rationale: Pure literature meta-extension. Lowest scientific impact (no new data) but zero-cost and 3-day ETA. Adds value as cross-citation backbone for our spontaneous-PCI analog (TOP-5 #5 Casali) by anchoring against published TEP-complexity normative ranges. Strategic value = closes citation chain.
falsifier_preregister_5: F1: review covers <80% of TEP-PCI literature 2010-2025 -> incomplete, extend
F2: meta-effect-size CI crosses 0 -> REJECT TEP-complexity-LOC link
F3: heterogeneity I^2 > 75% -> downgrade to qualitative narrative review
F4: publication bias funnel-plot asymmetric (Egger p<0.05) -> flag
F5: post-2024 studies contradict pre-2024 -> stratify by era

ranking.rationale: Tests COMPOSITION + INTRINSICALITY postulates — IIT predicts hierarchical neural systems develop richer cause-effect repertoires at higher levels. CLM layer-wise hidden-state differentiation across L1...L32 already partly implemented in state/an11_*. Marginal cost = re-run with formal Gandhi-style stimulus-class differentiation metric (Lempel-Ziv on layer activations). Lower impact than #9 because already partly done — incremental novelty only.
falsifier_preregister_5: F1: differentiation does NOT increase monotonically across layers -> REJECT hierarchy claim
F2: peak differentiation at mid-layer not top -> flag U-curve, not original linear claim
F3: stimulus-class differentiation collapses to token-frequency artifact -> control
F4: random-network baseline shows same hierarchical pattern -> REJECT trained-specificity
F5: effect size depends on stimulus modality (text-only) -> portability flag

ranking.rationale: Tests INFORMATION postulate — meaningful stimuli should produce more differentiated neural states than meaningless. CLM analog: differentiate hidden-states across coherent-prose vs scrambled-token stimuli. Slightly redundant with #15 (both ANALOGIZE differentiation) — separates by stimulus-meaningfulness axis vs hierarchy axis. Lowest of top-5 because high overlap with existing an11_b work.
falsifier_preregister_5: F1: meaningful vs scrambled differentiation effect d<0.5 -> REJECT
F2: effect explained by token-entropy difference alone -> trivial
F3: scrambled-but-grammatical control shows same differentiation -> meaning-vs-syntax confound
F4: effect vanishes after layer-norm rescaling -> magnitude-artifact
F5: depends on prompt length >100 tokens -> portability flag
